capabilities: Create full and differential ZIP backups on triggers such as startup, timers, edits, and app close
Verify backups via CRC, SHA-256, differential-chain checks, and in-memory rehearsal restores
Restore vaults, folders, or single notes to a separate restore folder or in place after a snapshot
Prune backups with newest-N, age-based, and daily/weekly/monthly retention rules plus pinned milestones
Encrypt backups with AES-256-GCM and browse past vault states in a read-only time travel view
extras: README warns the plugin has not yet been tested in a real Obsidian or on a phone, and that the backup folder should be excluded from Obsidian Sync, iCloud, Dropbox, and Git to avoid conflicts damaging backups. Standalone Node.js decrypt script provided so encrypted backups are not locked to the plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep verified, dated backups of the whole vault with retention rules, encryption, and a safe path to restore files or older note versions.
summary: Vault backup plugin that makes full or differential ZIP backups with verification, retention rules, optional AES-256-GCM encryption, and safe restore, on desktop and mobile.
